verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented Airbyte sandbox or test-environment feature that isolates testing from production data. Running a separate local instance via the OSS quickstart or abctl, or using Multiple Workspaces, is an adjacent arrangement made by the user rather than a sandbox capability. The Connector Builder evidence covers building connectors, not running tests against isolated non-production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
